completion_scope: Proof-only dry-run GC candidate planning and durable non-executable proposed intent; NOT deletion/cutover execution
intersection: Full-prefix RetainedPrefix/checkpoint; explicit confirmed reader inventory including actual storage progress; exact legacy/compact event-to-delivery manifest or real raw fact; compaction provenance; terminal Parquet + exact original sidecar full readback; exact original sealed spool archive readback; retention; owner lease snapshot + manifest leases; before/after value revalidation. Any failed conjunct blocks the whole cut.
intent_safety: PROPOSED_DRY_RUN, executable=False, requires_revalidation=True. Pin external evidence directory; O_NOFOLLOW/dir_fd and existing checkpoint writer on owned staging; atomic non-clobber hardlink, fsync and readback. Only owned staging cleanup is allowed. No source unlink/claim/reclaim/GC executor.
fixed_independent_defects: Output destination appearing during readback was overwritten
Evidence-parent rebind could overwrite owned fixture producer checkpoint
Unbounded evidence iterable materialized before limit
Durable plan omitted exact raw archive recovery locations
Raw archive mapping mutation during verify was not revalidated
fault_scope: Red tests mutate only disposable synthetic copies. Accepted happy/fault paths preserve original source and existing store state except deliberately injected callback mutations. No production data accessed.
limits: Caller-supplied confirmed-reader/lease registry is trusted owner input, not independent live lease authority. Full original prefix and preexisting exact raw spool archives are required; absence blocks. Existing upload/download methods are unchanged; no raw uploader or automatic retention/cutover added. Safe intent publication requires supported POSIX dir_fd/link/O_NOFOLLOW and /proc/self/fd; unsupported environments fail closed.
resource_bounds: <=128 segments, <=10000 candidate records, <=64MiB configured planning/readback budget, <=1MiB intent, <=501 items consumed to reject >500 evidence records; streaming hashing and existing source scan budgets. Repeated integrity scans/readback are maintenance work; no production CPU/RSS/PSS or all-process IO sizing claim.
